# Michael Mercier Tennis & Pickleball Instruction

> Master Professional, USPTA Hall of Fame Inductee, and 20-Year Head Tennis Professional at Harvard University offering elite private and semi-private tennis and pickleball coaching for juniors and adults across the North Shore of Massachusetts and Southern New Hampshire. Year-round instruction outdoors in season and indoors in winter.

## Services Offered
- **Private Tennis Coaching (1-on-1)**: Stroke biomechanics, modern kinetic chain forehand & backhand, high-percentage serve technique, video stroke analysis, and match strategy.
- **Private & Semi-Private Pickleball Coaching**: Third-shot drop mastery, non-volley zone (kitchen) reset and dinking strategy, fast-hands reload, stack positioning, transition from tennis to pickleball.
- **Junior High-Performance Development**: UTR tournament prep, high school varsity training, college tennis recruiting roadmap.
- **Adult League Coaching**: USTA New England and North Shore league doubles positioning, poaching, and partner communication.
- **Virtual Video Stroke Evaluation**: Remote 240fps video stroke diagnostic and voiceover analysis ($75).
- **Racquet Stringing & Customization**: Professional stringing with tension matching and lead tape balancing.
